tags.title: The Emerald Law
tags.lyrics-eng:
[ar: Probot]
[ti: The Emerald Law]
[al: Probot]
[id: ua_olcvissc]

[00:57.21]I do not die, but awaken from the dream i lived
[01:06.71]As above? so below, be revealed, the truth be known
[01:17.83]Questions, pieces strewn shrouded answers hewn
[01:22.73]With love so grow, beneath his paws the tablets glow
[01:27.97]
[01:28.48]Behold the falcon surveys the horizon
[01:33.25]Great scribe let us see, your runes of mystery
[01:38.83]Serpent shares your name, the keeper of eternal flames
[01:44.21]Prevail the law of three, the goddess guides humanity
[01:49.58]
[01:50.02]He weighs your heart a life pure a life false
[01:55.09]And they learn the sword decieved by false words
[02:00.21]And their greed and their lies cause them to be blind
[02:05.35]And so become, prevail the law of one
[02:11.51]And so become, the falcon
[02:15.70]And so become, the falcon
[02:21.51]
[02:47.59]And now the souls they swing
[02:52.58]Swirl in the cosmic ring
[02:58.13]Creations spark it has no time
[03:03.85]Rejoin the realm of divine
[03:08.31]
[04:16.89]Enthroned true one he sails into the sun
[04:21.35]Falcon at the helm glides through the netherrealm
[04:26.79]Be shown unseal the laws have been concealed
[04:32.15]Earthly majesty tables of destiny
[04:37.20]
[04:37.64]Bloodline blood trail
[04:40.55]The truth becomes the grail
[04:42.86]So far so near cloaked in the mists of fear
[04:47.97]Above below what's hidded will be shown
[04:53.46]Divine majesty true scrolls of destiny
[04:59.09]What's concealed will be revealed
[05:03.91]Those you see will be received
[05:09.62]The law of three, humanity
[05:15.04]The law of one, INTO THE SUN
